description: Is it safe to pay this address? One check before sending or accepting crypto: OFAC SDN sanctions screen, wallet age, EOA or contract, first funder and recent large transfers on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism or Polygon (wallet kind and activity on Solana), plus the token's 0-100 risk score when a token is given. Returns ok, caution or block with plain reasons and each check in full. Rules-based, not legal advice. Costs $0.02 USDC on Base via x402.

address.description: Address you are about to pay or receive from

chain.description: Chain of the payment; defaults to solana for base58 addresses, otherwise base

expect.description: What the address should be: eoa (a wallet), contract, or any (default); a mismatch gives caution

token.description: Token being paid or received (contract or mint on the same chain); adds its risk score

name: prepayment_safety_check
